abort.single_instance_allowed: Discord Bridge is already configured. This integration supports one configuration per Home Assistant instance.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Discord Bridge add-on at that address. Check the address Home Assistant itself can reach and that the add-on is running.
error.cannot_connect_discord: Could not reach the Discord API to validate the bot token.
error.invalid_auth: The queue token was rejected by the Discord Bridge add-on.
error.invalid_auth_discord: The Discord bot token was rejected by Discord.
error.no_mode: Enter at least one of the queue token (bridge mode) or the Discord bot token (direct mode).
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

data.author_id: Discord user ID to serve (author filter, recommended)
data.bridge_url: Bridge address reachable from Home Assistant (bridge mode)
data.channel_ids: Direct mode: channel IDs to watch (comma separated)
data.discord_bot_token: Discord bot token (direct mode; the same token the add-on uses)
data.queue_token: Queue token (bridge mode; the add-on's queue_token)
data.require_admin: Require an admin Home Assistant user for the API

user.description: Bridge mode talks to the Discord Bridge add-on on this host. Direct mode talks to the Discord API with the bot token. Either or both can be enabled; tokens never leave this Home Assistant.
user.title: Discord Bridge
